sql: SELECT d.company_name, count(*) AS listings_count FROM fct_posting f JOIN dim_company d USING (company_key) WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY d.company_name ORDER BY listings_count DESC LIMIT 3
reason: The request can be answered by joining fct_posting and dim_company and applying the standard filters for open remote-US listings.
